description: Widen only the shop Buy/Sell/Exit frame from 48 to 64 logical pixels for four-letter English labels

entries.note: Delay slot of jal 0x800bffb0: addiu a3,zero,48 becomes addiu a3,zero,64. The frame has x=24, y=86 and height=60; the text labels are drawn at x=36. No branch or target changes.
